review_summary: The junior differential captured the major organ systems but substantially underestimated the likelihood of several high‑prevalence complications of end‑stage renal disease. Probabilities have been recalibrated, critical missing work‑ups (cardiovascular, CKD‑MBD, glycemic verification, psychosocial) are highlighted, and the primary diagnosis remains diabetic ESRD with high confidence.
